# Cabaña 28

> Family-run Peruvian restaurant at 6351 N Andrews Ave, Fort Lauderdale, FL 33309. Known for pollo a la brasa (Peruvian rotisserie chicken), plus lomo saltado, ceviche and chaufa. Dine-in, pickup, delivery and catering.

- Phone: (954) 530-5123
- Hours: Monday to Friday 10:30am to 9pm; Saturday 10:15am to 9pm; Sunday 10:15am to 8pm
- Location: N Andrews Ave just north of Cypress Creek Rd, close to Oakland Park, Wilton Manors, Pompano Beach, Lauderdale Lakes, Tamarac
- Menu: 149 dishes with prices, including a kids menu
